testimonials.title: Over to our customers
testimonials.subtitle: Tradespeople, contractors and homeowners: they build with Solid-BTP.

reviews.name: Koffi Aristide
reviews.quote: For my job sites, Solid-BTP has become essential. Stock always available, precise advice and fair prices. It saves me so much time.

reviews.name: Mariam Touré
reviews.quote: I redid my whole kitchen thanks to them. The team guided me from tiling to paint. Flawless result and a warm welcome.

reviews.name: Jean-Baptiste N'Guessan
reviews.quote: Cables, breakers, lighting fixtures: it's all there, up to code. It's been my go-to hardware store since it opened.
